box.name: Implement real slugify in the a4-py-tools slug helper

outcome: In tools/slug.py make slugify(text) produce URL slugs: lowercase ASCII, every run of characters outside [a-z0-9] becomes a single hyphen, leading and trailing hyphens stripped, empty or non-string input maps to ''. Edit only the declared editable file.
checks: declared outcome: python checks/outcome.py rejects unslugged text; declared guard: python checks/guard.py keeps str/empty-input behavior green

submission.instructions: Edit only the file listed in box.json editable paths (tools/slug.py). It maps back to tools/slug.py in the owner repository. Make slugify(text) return lowercase ASCII slugs: runs of non-[a-z0-9] characters collapse to single hyphens, edge hyphens are stripped, empty or non-string input returns ''. Seal the work with node box/submit.mjs and return submission.json.
